================================================================================
HOW TO USE
================================================================================

1. INITIAL SETUP (One-time):
   cd /home/daisy/mayumi/Experimen/golang/github/xray-core-onering
   .github/scripts/setup.sh
   .github/scripts/verify-setup.sh

2. REPLACE PLACEHOLDERS:
   - Search and replace "YOUR_USERNAME" with GitHub username
   - Update all workflow files, documentation, scripts

3. ENABLE GITHUB ACTIONS:
   - Go to Settings → Actions → General
   - Enable "Allow all actions and reusable workflows"
   - Set permissions to "Read and write permissions"
   - Enable "Allow GitHub Actions to create and approve pull requests"

4. TRIGGER FIRST BUILD:
   git add .
   git commit -m "ci: add Multi-CDN workflows"
   git push origin main
   gh run watch

5. CREATE FIRST RELEASE:
   git tag -a v1.0.0 -m "Multi-CDN Release v1.0.0"
   git push origin v1.0.0
   gh release view v1.0.0

6. BUILD DOCKER IMAGE:
   # Automatic on push to main, or:
   gh workflow run docker-multicdn.yml -f tag=latest
   docker pull ghcr.io/YOUR_USERNAME/xray-core-onering:latest

7. LOCAL DEVELOPMENT:
   .github/scripts/build-local.sh     # Single platform
   .github/scripts/build-all.sh       # All platforms
   .github/scripts/quickstart.sh      # Test binary
